Playbook.name: Change Audit — Kaspersky USB/CD Device-Control Policy Changed - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: The Kaspersky device-control policy (USB/CD allow/block rules) was changed (KLAUD_EV_ADMGROUP_CHANGED with Allow USB/CD content). Triage: authorised device-policy administration, or an attacker/insider weakening device control to enable exfiltration?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Weakening device-control policy opens a removable-media exfiltration/malware channel.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Kaspersky Security Center CEF (verified live). Fields: destination.domain (the affected ENDPOINT, not the collector), destination.user.name, cef.device.event_class_id, cef.name, message (malware name/path/SHA256), source.ip. Use destination.domain as the host of interest.

Input.name: $admin
Input.description: Admin/actor who changed the policy if present.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the device-control policy change is authorised administration or a weakening for exfil.

Step.name: The device-control policy change
Step.Purpose: What changed (allow rules added) and by whom separates admin work from weakening.
Step.Query: FROM logs-cef.log-* | WHERE cef.device.vendor == "KasperskyLab" AND cef.device.event_class_id == "KLAUD_EV_ADMGROUP_CHANGED" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, cef.name, message, destination.user.name, source.ip | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 20
Step.AnalystNotes: An 'Allow USB - CD' rule added, especially broadly or by an unexpected admin, weakens device control. A scoped, ticketed change by a known admin is routine. Read message for the rule detail.

Node.Condition: A broad allow-rule added to device control by an unexpected actor with no change record.
A scoped device-policy change by a known Kaspersky admin under a ticket.
An admin over-broadening a rule by mistake.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-USBPOL-CHANGE to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Verify the change; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: Weakening device control to enable exfiltration.

SOCAction.Item: Reverse the policy change; review removable-media use since; open IR.

Misconfiguration.Definition: An admin over-broadening device policy by mistake.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the policy change and actor.
If unauthorised, reverse and review media use.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Reverse the change; review removable-media use since; interview the actor.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce change control on device-control policy; alert on allow-rule additions.

QualityChecks.Check: Kaspersky reports the endpoint in destination.domain (host.* is the collector pod) - always pivot on destination.domain.
The CEF pipeline occasionally mislabels events - see the pipeline health note in the phase-1 report.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Policy restored; media use reviewed; actor addressed.
